observation.command:
cp .env.example .env
sed -i "s|^API_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY=.*|API_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY=$(openssl rand -base64 32)|" .env
sed -i "s|^APP_DOMAIN=.*|APP_DOMAIN=localhost|" .env
sed -i "s|^INITIAL_ADMIN_PASSWORD=.*|INITIAL_ADMIN_PASSWORD=adminpass123|" .env
sed -i "s|^SWAGGER_HTTP_AUTH_PASSWORD=.*|SWAGGER_HTTP_AUTH_PASSWORD=swaggerpass123|" .env
sed -i "s|^LETSENCRYPT_EMAIL=.*|LETSENCRYPT_EMAIL=admin@example.com|" .env
grep -E "API_CREDENTIAL|APP_DOMAIN|ADMIN_PASSWORD|SWAGGER" .env
